coaching.title: Ways to train with me
coaching.intro: All bookings by text or email. Every plan starts with a free 15-minute chat about where you are and where you want to get to.
coaching.onlineText: Your plan, check-ins and support, wherever you live and train.

runClub.headline: Run together. Get faster.
paragraphs: Run Club is a weekly group session for runners of every level, whether you’re training for your first 5K or your next ultra.
Every session is tailored to your experience, so you’re pushed at the right level and never left behind. Expect intervals, hills and tempo work, plenty of hard effort and a good laugh along the way.

photos.alt: Peter and three other runners with medals holding a Walters & Co banner at the Kerry Way Ultra finish
A runner with poles heading along a grassy trail into misty green hills
Peter pointing at his name on the runners’ wall at the Valencia Marathon

about.name: Peter Rothwell
paragraphs: I found fitness in my early twenties and was obsessed almost straight away. A few years later I made it my career. Now I run ultra marathons and coach athletes from every background.
Most of what I teach is about mental fortitude: giving you the tools, the structure and the push to get past the limits you thought you had.

photo.alt: Peter smiling in a climbing helmet on a rocky ledge high in the mountains
